_doc: D2 combat readability (render only). facingMs180 = time a sprite needs to turn 180 deg (AGENTS-PLAN B5: ~80 ms). hitFlash: minGapMs = at most one flash per unit per gap (4/s), amp = brightness boost per target kind. airborne: hop height (world units) over the knock-up; dash: arc height per 100 units of dash length (only when the snapshot carries `dashing`, agent B5).
